name: Hotel Zamora
insider_take: This Moorish-inspired boutique gem rises like a Mediterranean castle along Florida's Gulf Coast, where Spanish Revival architecture meets modern luxury just steps from sugar-white sands.
whats_special: Hotel Zamora's striking design features authentic Spanish tiles, wrought-iron balconies, and a rooftop terrace offering panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico. The property's signature Castile Restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine in an elegant setting reminiscent of old-world Spain, while the hotel sits on the historic Pass-a-Grille district - one of Florida's oldest beach communities.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the rooftop Castile Restaurant - the unobstructed Gulf views during golden hour are absolutely magical, and you'll avoid the crowds at nearby beach bars.
dont_miss: Explore the charming Pass-a-Grille Historic District with its quaint shops and art galleries, or take a short walk to the southern tip of St. Pete Beach where you can watch both sunrise and sunset over the water - a rare geographic treat on Florida's west coast.
pros: Stunning rooftop pool and bar with panoramic views of Boca Ciega Bay and the Gulf of Mexico
Boutique Mediterranean-inspired architecture offering a unique and intimate atmosphere
Prime St. Pete Beach location within walking distance of white-sand beaches and local dining
Exceptional on-site dining at The Canopy restaurant featuring fresh coastal cuisine and craft cocktails
IHG Destined Program perks including exclusive benefits and elevated service for discerning travelers
cons: Boutique property with limited number of rooms, so availability may be restricted during peak season
Car recommended for exploring beyond the immediate St. Pete Beach area
